name: r3_ramsey_three_three
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] (h : 6 ≤ Fintype.card V) (G : SimpleGraph V) : ¬ G.CliqueFree 3 ∨ ¬ Gᶜ.CliqueFree 3
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (h : 6 ≤ Fintype.card V) (G : SimpleGraph V), ¬ G.CliqueFree 3 ∨ ¬ Gᶜ.CliqueFree 3
informal: R(3,3) ≤ 6: every graph on at least 6 vertices contains a triangle or its complement does. Proof idea: pick a vertex v; among the ≥ 5 other vertices, pigeonhole gives 3 neighbours or 3 non-neighbours; if two of the 3 neighbours are adjacent we get a triangle in G with v, otherwise they form a triangle in the complement (and symmetrically).
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V], 6 ≤ Fintype.card V → ∀ (G : SimpleGraph V), ¬G.CliqueFree 3 ∨ ¬Gᶜ.CliqueFree 3
